newsitem.title: GREECE: GREECE TO RECEIVE 29MLN ECU AID ON ENVIRONMENT.
newsitem.headline: GREECE TO RECEIVE 29MLN ECU AID ON ENVIRONMENT.

text.p: Greece will receive subsidies totalling 29 million ecu on three environmental projects by the Funding Mechanism of the European Economic Area (EEA) through the European Investment Bank (EIB), the EIB said in a statement.

The funds will be appropriated by the Greek state among investment plans for the purchase of fire-fighting equipment, surveillance of marine pollution, climatic conditions and water quality, as well as urban development in the municipality of Kalamata, it said.
The EEA's Funding Mechanism represents the contribution of Austria, Finland, Iceland, Lichtenstein, Norway and Sweden in exchange for their inclusion to the EU's free-trade zone.

It is aimed at alleviating social and economic imbalances among EU-member states, financing investments that contribute to the protection of the environment and cultural heritage and improving transportation, education and human resources.
The funding mechanism includes interest subsidisation on loans totaling 1.5 billion ecu which are handed out by the EIB to Ireland, Greece, Portugal and some regions of Spain.
The aid package covers 85 percent of total budgeted investments which are expected to see completion by 1999. --Angelos Kiosklis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
